description: Reproducibility envelopes (FR-10) as they were written by past versions of the engine. NOT a golden dataset in the color-golden sense — it makes no claim about physical reality, so it needs no ADR to extend. It is a REGRESSION fixture: every one of these must still parse, still compare, and still serialise byte-identically after the code has moved on. The versions here are deliberately NOT the current ones. A fixture written from today's CORE_VERSION passes today for the wrong reason — it compares the current code to itself — and stops meaning anything the moment a version bumps.

entries.note: The shape before personal profiles existed. `profile` absent, not null — an envelope without a profile must have ONE serialisation, not two.

The same versions with a profile. Key order is fixed by serialiseEnvelope rather than by insertion order, because two code paths building the same envelope can disagree about insertion order and JSON.stringify follows it.
A pre-release engine version. Semver allows it and the parser must too, or a beta build writes envelopes nobody can replay.
Rule weights and the corpus version independently (F-029 ships rules from content/ on the same publish scheme). An envelope where they differ is normal and must round-trip.
